decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered Arch 198 and Design and Access Statement and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 3 - Prior to the occupation of the premises the doors to the property shall be enhanced with high quality seals to the perimeter and threshold, in accordance with the Acoustic Assessment provided for the adjacent premises. The doors shall be airtight when closed. Self door closers should also be installed.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of the activity at the site, a noise-limiting device shall be installed on the sound system. The noise limiter shall have a maximum level of 90dB(A) with a 5dB tolerance. The noise-limiting device shall not be removed, and only the in-house sound system can be used within the studio.
Condition : 5 - The hours of operation of the dance studio at Arch 198 shall be limited to 9am to 10pm daily, unless prior approval has been sought from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - There shall be no loading/unloading or parking within the alley way to the south of the arch (that provides pedestrian access to the Welstead Way carpark to the rear).
description: Change of use from motor garage to dance studio.
